verdict.description: pass only if every change in the evidence is understood and safe for this repository; unsure if anything could not be checked.

summary.description: Plain-text reasoning a human can audit: what was diffed, what changed, how the repository uses it, and the decision. No links, no @-mentions, no markdown headings.

items.description: One entry for every item in the flagged list of evidence.json, with update, code and item copied exactly; [] when the list is empty. A pass merges only if every flagged item is here, nothing else is, and each is benign.

assessment.description: benign only if you read exactly what changed and can say what it does and why that is safe; suspicious if it could be malicious; unclear if you could not tell.

note.description: What the item does, in plain text: why it is benign, or what is suspicious or unclear about it.

commits.description: Full hashes of the upstream commits listed for this item in the upstream.md evidence file whose stated purpose explains this change; [] when none are listed. Benign needs at least one when commits are listed.
